title: Rules
subtitle: How achievements, leaderboard points, titles, and best answers work.
achievement_summary: Achievements use the original badge points system and learning progress records.
achievement_1: Badge points are separate from leaderboard points.
achievement_3: Each like received on your posts gives 2 badge points.
achievement_4: Badges unlock at 50, 150, 300, and 600 badge points.
achievement_5: Progress achievements unlock from learning activity, such as answering 10 questions, posting 5 questions, getting 20 correct answers, reaching 80% accuracy after at least 5 attempts, improving by 20%, receiving 10 likes, or receiving 50 likes.
leaderboard_summary: The leaderboard uses a separate total points track.
leaderboard_1: All Time ranks users by total leaderboard points.
leaderboard_2: This Week sums point transactions from the last 7 days.
leaderboard_3: This Month sums point transactions from the last 30 days.
leaderboard_4: Users can hide from the leaderboard with their privacy setting.
leaderboard_5: The all-time top three can wear Champion, Runner-up, or Third Place beside their name.
titles_summary: Title badges are determined from the all-time leaderboard only.
titles_1: Champion, Runner-up, and Third Place are assigned to ranks 1, 2, and 3 on the All Time leaderboard.
titles_2: Ranking uses total leaderboard points in descending order.
titles_3: When points are tied, the user with the smaller user ID ranks higher.
titles_4: Users with 0 all-time points do not receive title badges.
titles_5: Users hidden from leaderboard or who disable wearing leaderboard titles will not display these badges.
points_note: Self-awards and self-upvotes do not count.
best_answer_summary: Best answer helps highlight the strongest answer on question posts.
best_answer_1: Only question posts can show a best answer preview.
best_answer_2: The system compares comment scores using upvotes minus downvotes.
best_answer_3: A comment must have a score above 1 to qualify.
best_answer_4: If scores tie, the earlier comment is selected first.
best_answer_5: The AI panel explains why the selected answer is helpful; users should still judge the answer carefully.
manual_summary: Open this guide when you need a quick reminder of the main learning community workflow.
manual_step_1: Register or log in before using the community features.
manual_step_2: Use the language switcher to choose English, Bahasa Malaysia, or Mandarin.
manual_step_3: Browse posts from the home page, categories page, following feed, or search bar.
manual_step_4: Create a post by entering a title, content, post type, subject, language, and optional attachments.
manual_step_5: Turn on anonymous posting if you want to ask a question without showing your name and avatar.
manual_step_6: Open a post to reply, like helpful content, save it to your study folder, or follow the author.
manual_step_7: Check your profile, achievements, bookmarks, and leaderboard to track learning activity and progress.
